comment: The DSP is the Kammerl Kaske alternative firmware for Clouds, vendored at alt_firmware/kammerl, in the Monsoon layout; src/fluctus.cpp is the Rack wrapper, resampling to the hardware's 32kHz. It replaces Nebulae's spectral mode with spectral clouds, a banded filter with randomly modulated bands, and adds the Kammerl beat repeater; in that last mode the four right-hand knobs and the pitch control are all re-read as slice probability, clock divider, pitch modulation, feedback and playback speed. The pitch jack is read twice: as one volt per octave at fluctus.cpp:303, and again at fluctus.cpp:309, divided by 5 and clamped to 0..1, as the beat repeater's playback speed; the source carries a TODO there saying the firmware subtracts 0.5 from the incoming voltage and the wrapper does not. Every jack is read with getVoltage() or getVoltageSum(), so nothing here is polyphonic, and the right audio input is normalled to the left at fluctus.cpp:209. The freeze gate and the trigger both read high at 1V. The hardware's ability to save and load the audio buffer is not implemented.
